audience.title: Fits the way your business works
audience.teamTitle: The team works together - each with the information they need
audience.teamBody: Invite workers and managers and define who sees projects, expenses, changes, and profitability. You can also hide areas that are not relevant to the business.

items.a: Project, job, and service businesses - contractors, renovations, field trades, maintenance, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, and project managers.

items.q: Does it also fit a small business?
items.a: Yes. You can start with clients, jobs, and basic expenses - without turning everything on.

items.q: Can I manage both projects and service calls?
items.a: Yes. You can manage projects, jobs, and service calls according to the type of work.

items.q: Do I have to use every capability?
items.a: No. Turn on only what you need. A small business stays simple.

items.q: How do I know if a project is profitable?
items.a: You see how much it has already cost, how much you have committed, how much was billed and received, and the expected profit.

items.q: Can I manage budget versus actuals?
items.a: Yes. You see planned budget against recorded cost, commitments, and cost forecast.

items.q: Can I manage a bill of quantities and progress invoices?
items.a: Yes. You can manage items, measure progress, and prepare progress invoices when that capability is on.

items.q: Does the system warn when a project starts to overrun?
items.a: Yes. ProjectFlow shows when a project starts to overrun budget, when profitability is eroding, or when collections are delayed.

items.q: Can I manage employees, hours, and attendance?
items.a: Yes. You can manage employees, time reporting, attendance, and scheduling.

items.q: Can I manage vendors and subcontractors?
items.a: Yes. Vendors, purchase orders, supplier invoices, and subcontractors can be linked to the work.

items.q: Can I photograph or upload an invoice?
items.a: Yes. Photograph or upload an invoice. The system suggests details and prepares a draft for review.

items.q: Can workers use it from a phone?
items.a: Yes. The same system is mobile-ready - reports, expenses, and invoice capture are available in the field.

items.q: Can I produce reports for a client?
items.a: Yes. You can produce PDF reports for project status, financial summary, progress, changes, and daily logs.
Yes. You can install it from the browser to the home screen or desktop when the device supports it.

items.q: Does every worker see the financial data?
items.a: No. You set permissions - each person sees what they need.
No. ProjectFlow is for managing the work, costs, billing, and profitability. Keep bookkeeping in the system meant for that.
